label: copy-phase input v (fed back), from the 4th output on
explanation: Token-specific copy-phase feature: fires when the fed-back input is the letter v during the copy phase, i.e. the model just emitted v and is now outputting a later original token (recall_idx >= 3, so v was original token >= 2). 99.98% of mass is on in_tok=v; it essentially never fires on v in the original phase, at the delimiter, or on other tokens. Magnitude is larger late in the sequence (few outputs left, to_go 0-2) and in longer sequences; v echoed at recall_idx 2 (v as original token 1) gives only weak activations, and early-recalled v with many outputs remaining (to_go >= 6) is silent. Does not depend on the output token, previous tokens, or first token.

issues: Systematic miss class: v fed back at recall_idx 2 in short sequences (to_go <= 1, i.e. L = 3-4) fires almost every time. The predicate (phase==2)&(in_tok==v)&(recall_idx==2)&(to_go<=1) has test precision 0.998 over 2916 steps and accounts for ~5.0% of active steps (2.7% of mass). The test misses output is entirely made of these cases, e.g. 'y v s <DEL> y [v:0.51]' and 'g v z <DEL> g [v:0.53]', with activations of 0.13-0.53 of max. So the explanation's 'when v is echoed at recall_idx 2, activations are weak' is incomplete: the gate is to_go/end-of-sequence, not just recall_idx, and the label 'from the 4th output on' overclaims a hard cutoff.
The rest of recall_idx==2 almost never fires: recall_idx==2 overall has precision 0.18, and with to_go >= 2 it is essentially silent. So the activation depends jointly on recall_idx and to_go.

Remaining false positives cluster at recall_idx==3 with to_go >= 4 (long L = 8-9 sequences, v at original position 2): precision 0.64 over 5419 steps. Examples: 'k w v q j y 3 j <DEL> k w *v* q ...' and 'j y v f o c d m 1 <DEL> j y *v* ...'. This is a minor, partly graded edge.

Confirmed claims: activation is copy-phase only (9 original-phase actives in dev, 0 at the delimiter). in_tok==v holds ~100% of the mass. v outside the copy phase has precision 1e-4. No dependence on out_tok or prev_tok. Mass is concentrated at to_go 0-2. Nothing fires at to_go >= 6. Reported test scores for the original predicate reproduce exactly (P 0.953, R 0.946, F1 0.949, mass recall 0.973).

to_go-only alternatives are worse: (in_tok==v)&(to_go<=4) has F1 0.843 because v fed back at recall_idx 0-1 near the end of short sequences does not fire. So recall_idx is still needed alongside to_go.
skeptic.revised_label: copy-phase fed-back input v, late in recall (recall_idx >= 3, or recall_idx 2 when at most 1 output remains)
